intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi celebrated festivals all year long! 🎉
Today is Errand Day — Kimi and Mom are going ALL around the town!

scenes.title: A Walk in the Park
scenes.caption:
The breeze is nice, the flowers are pretty...
Look, but don't pick!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's great weather for a walk. Say hi to our neighbors!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Hi! Wow, there are a lot of people at the park!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't pick the flowers. Don't throw trash on the ground.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I need the restroom!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Knock on the door before going in. Flush when you're done, and wash your hands well. 🚻

scenes.title: Supermarket Mission
scenes.caption:
Mission list: fruit, fish, and...
RAMEN ON SALE?!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Mommy needs to go grocery shopping. Go get a cart.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Let's see the grocery list! 📝

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's go to the produce corner first. Put it in the cart.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom! The pack of ramen is on sale! Can we get it?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Check if we forgot anything. ...The cart is full! 🛒

scenes.title: Lunch at the Restaurant
scenes.caption:
Menus, chopsticks, and yummy smells.
But no goofing around!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Hello, may I order now? I want zhajiangmian and sweet and sour pork! 🍜

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Can you set the spoons and chopsticks?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I spilled my water... 😅

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't goof around in the restaurant. ...Can we get the check, please?

scenes.title: Movie Time!
scenes.caption:
A 3D movie, a big popcorn,
and ten minutes till it starts!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I want to watch a 3D movie! Did you reserve the tickets, Mom?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Yes, I got the tickets beforehand. Let's watch a matinee.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Can I get popcorn and a drink? 🍿

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: We have about 10 minutes till the movie starts. Wait in line here and go in.

scenes.title: Shhh! Book Land
scenes.caption:
Dinosaur books, storybooks, science magazines...
but remember: library voices only!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Where are the dinosaur books? 🦕

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Pick what you want to read. Don't be loud in the library.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: How many books can I borrow?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: We can only get 4 books. Let's check them out. Give the librarian the card first. 🤫

scenes.title: Kimi's First Bank Account
scenes.caption:
Last stop: the bank.
Kimi's piggy bank savings become REAL money today!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: What is a bank for, Mom?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: We keep money in the bank. Let's open an account for you!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I want to save my piggy bank money here! 🐷

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Get a number and we need to fill out the form. Good job, big saver! 💰

ending.title: Errand Day: Complete!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Big Adventures! 🏖️
